Subject: Your anticipatory bail matter - FIR No. 1647/2019

Dear Ms. Patel,

Thank you for meeting us on 6 December 2019 about your dispute with Harish Kulkarni. As we understand it, the complaint was filed during a matrimonial dispute. The matter is listed before the Thane Sessions Court.

Our advice is to seek interim protection and offer to attend mediation. Please collect the marriage certificate and messages showing attempts to settle and send copies to this office.

Regards,
Adv. Sharmila Venkatesan
